cross.intro: Here you create admins for other companies. Of other companies you only see the name and short name – no user lists and no results.
cross.newCompany: Create admin for a new company
cross.newCompanyHint: The company is created with its email domain; the new admin receives an invitation email and then manages the company on their own.
cross.companyCreated: Company {company} created – the invitation to {email} has been sent.
cross.existingCompany: Create admin for an existing company
cross.existingHint: The email address must belong to a domain of the selected company. That company's admins are notified by email.
cross.noCompanies: There are no other companies yet.
cross.adminCreated: Admin created – the invitation to {email} has been sent.
cross.createdHint: You can switch these accounts to another role, activate/deactivate them, resend the invitation or reset the password. The admins of the respective company are notified. Only admins of the same company can delete them.
cross.noCreated: You have not created any admins for other companies yet.
cross.resetTitle: Reset password for a user of another company
cross.resetHint: Enter the full email address. For privacy reasons there is no list and no search; the response is the same for known and unknown addresses.
